summary: Request: Bulk channel privacy changes + periodic role-audit bot for contractor channels
description:
Issue summary:
Support/Compliance request to standardize and automate lifecycle actions for Slack channels that include contractors or external guests. Two parts: (1) a one-time bulk change to set privacy for a curated list of ~120 channels to 'Private' and update channel descriptions with data classification tags; (2) deploy a scheduled bot (role-audit-bot) that runs weekly to detect channels with contractor guests, verify channel privacy and membership roles, and open Jira tickets for any drift.

Business impact:
- Current audit found ~18 contractor-facing channels left public or shared with wide org groups. This exposes conversations and may violate data classification policy for contractor workstreams.
- Manual remediation is time-consuming and error-prone; recurring drift has been observed when owners re-open channels or add broad groups.

Request details / acceptance criteria:
1) Bulk action: run Slack API script to set privacy to Private for the attached channel list, update the channel topic/description to include: "DataClass: Contractor-PII-Nearby" and add pinned reference to the contractor onboarding doc. Provide dry-run output and a reversible plan (unable to auto-convert back to public without owner consent noted).
2) Bot: deploy a scheduled automation that every Monday at 02:00 UTC does: scan all channels for members with email domain not @redwood.com or flagged as external/guest; for any public/shared channel containing contractor guests, (a) send a DM to channel owners with remediation steps, (b) create an internal-support Jira ticket (project=internal-support, label=contractor-audit) listing channel, offending members, and suggested action, and (c) if not remediated within 7 days, escalate to Compliance.
3) Provide runbook and a Confluence page documenting the bot, owner opt-out flow, and how to request exceptions.
4) All changes must include a rollback checklist and a timestamped audit log entry in Confluence and link back to created Jira tickets.

Background and constraints:
- Legal/Compliance require awareness for any automation that modifies channel privacy; we must include an owner-notification flow and a 24-hour owner approval window before automatic privacy enforcement when the channel owner is not part of the contractor team.
- On bulk privacy updates, Slack does not allow converting private->public via API; we must record channels changed and instruct owners on how to request public restoration.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: false positive detection of contractor membership for vendors with dual emails. Mitigation: bot will skip accounts with an approved identity provider flag (idp:partner-approved) and include a manual review link.
- Risk: disruption of active channels if privacy enforced unexpectedly. Mitigation: owner DM with 24h window, dry-run and staging run only on a small pilot cohort first.

Timeline proposal:
- Mar 16: pilot run on 12 channels (dry-run + owner notifications).
- Mar 23: review pilot, address feedback.
- Apr 1: bulk change + bot activation in production.

Acceptance criteria (final):
- All channels in the provided list either successfully set to Private or have documented owner opt-outs/exceptions on Confluence.
- Bot runs weekly and has created at least one automated ticket during pilot demonstrating workflow.
- Runbook and rollback checklist published and reviewed by Security and Compliance.
comments: 2026-02-25 - Evelyn Cho: Filing initial request after quarterly compliance audit flagged contractor channels. Attached CSV with 120 channel IDs in Confluence page.
2026-02-27 - Samir Singh: Ack'ed. I'll spin up a dry-run script in staging and propose a pilot list. Need confirmation on 'owner approval' window - is 24h acceptable to Compliance?

2026-03-01 - Priya Nair (Compliance): 24h is acceptable for low-risk channels; for channels tagged 'legal' or 'finance' we require 72h and explicit escalation. Please add classification exceptions to runbook.
2026-03-05 - Samir Singh: Pilot prepared (12 channels). Dry-run output posted to Confluence. Scheduling pilot for Mar 16. Need SRE to approve scheduled lambda time window (02:00 UTC).

2026-03-14 - Diego Ramos (SRE): 02:00 UTC works. Recommend throttling API calls to avoid rate limits and include exponential backoff. Also suggest we create a dedicated service account and rotate its token post-deploy.
investigation_notes: Checked channel metadata for sample set: 12/12 channels returned expected member lists via conversations.members API call.
Observed two accounts with dual emails (vendor@partner.com and vendor+alt@redwood.com) that caused potential false positives; will add idp exception check.
Slack API rate limit observed during large list pagination; implemented chunking to 50 channels per minute in staging script.
Confluence audit log template drafted and linked in runbook; needs Compliance sign-off.
resolution_notes: Pilot scheduled for 2026-03-16. Post-pilot actions: update runbook with 72h exception for legal/finance channels, finalize service account rotation schedule, and merge PR #299 to enable owner-notification email template.
If pilot OK, plan bulk change April 1 with 48h pre-notice posted to #internal-ops and owners.
